rules.name: Characters require permanent IDs
rules.enforcement: Recurring characters are referenced by stable CHAR_* IDs and never only by prose descriptions.

rules.name: Character references control identity
rules.enforcement: Approved character references control face and body; wardrobe references control clothing unless an approved reference explicitly has both roles.

rules.name: Character sheets cover identity views
rules.enforcement: Use front, three-quarter, profile, back, full-body, close-up, neutral, and production wardrobe views when they strengthen identity.

rules.name: Wardrobe changes create state versions
rules.enforcement: Intentional wardrobe or damage changes create new states; never overwrite approved history.
